d:
After Sophia devoured the universe and became Universe Goddess, she didn't feel it was enough. Sophia craved for more power.
She ordered her clones to travel to other universes and brought her even more energy.
But after she absorbed the universes, an accident occurred. Sophia lost all her power.
Everything went back to normal.
And here, a new adventure begun.
The beginning of '##$$##'s Revenge'
